notes.summary: The page continues a preceding argument by stating that D is linearly equivalent to 0. It voices confidence in separatedness of Corr, discusses Pic and a quotient presentation, then discusses projective embeddings and use of Chow’s lemma. It names a difficulty concerning the displayed cohomology expression and begins a topology approach through specialization of fundamental groups. The last sentence continues beyond this page. These are descriptions of what the page says; no proof has been verified in this reading.

visual_decisions: Single underlines and the plain P were checked independently at every occurrence.
The three o glyphs in line 22 were decided from their strokes and height relative to H, X and O. No cohomology convention was substituted.
No arrow was supplied in the blank between X and Pic.
The printed not, loose (twice), affraid (twice), morphisme and factors,of remain unchanged.
H’s opening editorial note was treated as witness commentary, not transcribed page text.
